Pick up from Surabaya airport - *Taman Langit - transfer to hotel.

3.30am check out - *Kapas Biru Panorama & Teras Semeru - breakfast - Tumpak Sewu Waterfall

*May skipped if too tired/ bad weather (Refund IDR90k/pax + IDR100k guide fares)

itinerary_days.title: Day 5
itinerary_days.activity_text: Check out hotel before 12pm - free and easy - airport

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Surabaya to the Mystical Bromo Area
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your Bromo and Ijen adventure begins as we greet you at Surabaya Airport, with an early pick-up (best before noon). From there, we’ll embark on a 3-hour scenic drive to the iconic Cemoro Lawang, the gateway to the Bromo Area. Along the way, enjoy the changing landscapes of East Java as we make our way to the hotel. Upon arrival at your hotel, Joglo Kecombrang Bromo, you’ll have time to rest and take in the quiet beauty of the surroundings. Prepare for the exciting days ahead as you settle in for a peaceful evening.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Bromo Sunrise to the Hidden Gems of Madakaripura
itinerary_days.activity_text: Our day begins in the early hours (around 1:00 AM), with a thrilling stargazing session, followed by a view of the Milky Way. As the first light of dawn breaks, witness the spectacular sunrise over the volcanic landscape of Bromo. The dormant Mount Batok, the active Mount Bromo, and the towering Mount Semeru are all part of this majestic view that stretches across the caldera. After sunrise, we continue our journey over the expansive Pasir (Sand Sea) in a 4WD, heading to the Poten Temple. From here, you can choose to either take a 3km hike or ride a pony to the base of Mount Bromo. A steep 253-step climb rewards you with a close-up view of the crater rim, where you can witness the raw power of the active volcano. We then set off for Madakaripura Waterfall, about an hour’s drive away. A short 30-minute trek through the lush greenery (wear your slippers!) will lead you to this magnificent waterfall, a stunning natural beauty nestled deep in the hills. After taking in the sight, we continue our journey to Bondowoso for an overnight stay.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.itinerary: From Ijen Crater to Bali’s Shores
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your day begins at midnight, as we head out from Bondowoso to Ijen. After a 90-minute drive to Paltuding, we’ll start the trek to Ijen Crater. This 1 to 1.5-hour hike leads you to the crater rim, where you’ll stand in awe of the 200-meter deep, turquoise sulfuric lake. You’ll also get to witness the grueling work of the local sulfur miners as they carry heavy sacks through toxic fumes and harsh terrain to make a living. After experiencing the crater’s sunrise view, we’ll descend and proceed to Ketapang Harbour, where you’ll board the ferry to Bali (ticket included). The journey to the island is the perfect way to conclude your Ijen adventure, as we leave Java behind and head to the tropical paradise of Bali.

product.package_name: 3 Day Bromo, Madakaripura Waterfall & Ijen Overland from Surabaya to Bali

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your Bromo and Ijen adventure begins as we greet you at Surabaya Airport, with an early pick-up (best before noon). From there, we’ll embark on a 3-hour scenic drive to the iconic Cemoro Lawang, the gateway to the Bromo Area. Along the way, enjoy the changing landscapes of East Java as we make our way to the hotel. Upon arrival at your hotel, Joglo Kecombrang Bromo, you’ll have time to rest and take in the quiet beauty of the surroundings. Prepare for the exciting days ahead as you settle in for a peaceful evening.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.activity_text: Our day begins in the early hours (around 1:00 AM), with a thrilling stargazing session, followed by a view of the Milky Way. As the first light of dawn breaks, witness the spectacular sunrise over the volcanic landscape of Bromo. The dormant Mount Batok, the active Mount Bromo, and the towering Mount Semeru are all part of this majestic view that stretches across the caldera. After sunrise, we continue our journey over the expansive Pasir (Sand Sea) in a 4WD, heading to the Poten Temple. From here, you can choose to either take a 3km hike or ride a pony to the base of Mount Bromo. A steep 253-step climb rewards you with a close-up view of the crater rim, where you can witness the raw power of the active volcano. We then set off for Madakaripura Waterfall, about an hour’s drive away. A short 30-minute trek through the lush greenery (wear your slippers!) will lead you to this magnificent waterfall, a stunning natural beauty nestled deep in the hills. After taking in the sight, we continue our journey to Bondowoso for an overnight stay.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your day begins at midnight, as we head out from Bondowoso to Ijen. After a 90-minute drive to Paltuding, we’ll start the trek to Ijen Crater. This 1 to 1.5-hour hike leads you to the crater rim, where you’ll stand in awe of the 200-meter deep, turquoise sulfuric lake. You’ll also get to witness the grueling work of the local sulfur miners as they carry heavy sacks through toxic fumes and harsh terrain to make a living. After experiencing the crater’s sunrise view, we’ll descend and proceed to Ketapang Harbour, where you’ll board the ferry to Bali (ticket included). The journey to the island is the perfect way to conclude your Ijen adventure, as we leave Java behind and head to the tropical paradise of Bali.

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your tour begins with a pick-up at I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) in Bali or from your hotel (preferably before 9:00 AM local time). Upon arrival at Ketapang Port, continue your journey with a 4-hour drive to your hotel in the Bromo area. Check in, relax, and rest before your next adventure

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.activity_text: At around 02:00 AM, prepare for a thrilling Mount Bromo Stargazing and Milky Way View. After immersing yourself in the beauty of the night sky, head to the viewing spot for sunrise over the Bromo landscape. You'll witness the stunning sight of Mount Batok, Mount Bromo, and Gunung Semeru, Indonesia's highest and most active volcano, looming majestically in the background. After the sunrise, embark on an exciting 4WD ride or motorcycle journey across the vast volcanic sand sea (Laotan Pasir) to Poten, a Tenggerese Hindu temple near Mount Bromo. From here, you have the option to either hike 3km or take a pony ride to the base of Mount Bromo, where you can climb the 253 steps to the crater rim for close-up views of the active crater. After enjoying the spectacular views of the Bromo crater, continue your journey to Bondowoso City. Check into your hotel and recharge your energy in preparation for the Ijen Crater hike the next day.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3

At the crater rim, be mesmerized by the gigantic turquoise sulfuric crater lake, one of the most unique sights in Java. While at the crater, you'll have the chance to observe the world’s toughest sulfur miners who brave toxic fumes and hazardous terrain to carry 70kg sacks of sulfur. This is a truly humbling experience that reveals the hardships faced by these workers. After watching the breathtaking sunrise and exploring the crater, return to the parking area for a brief break and enjoy a cup of Arabica coffee. Finally, we will transfer you to Ketapang Harbour to take the ferry back to Bali, bringing your volcanic adventure to a close. End of the program.

itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your Bromo and Ijen adventure begins as we greet you at Surabaya Airport, with an early pick-up (best before noon). From there, we’ll embark on a 3-hour scenic drive to the iconic Cemoro Lawang, the gateway to the Bromo Area. Along the way, enjoy the changing landscapes of East Java as we make our way to the hotel. Upon arrival at your hotel, Joglo Kecombrang Bromo, you’ll have time to rest and take in the quiet beauty of the surroundings. Prepare for the exciting days ahead as you settle in for a peaceful evening.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.activity_text: Our day begins in the early hours (around 1:00 AM), with a thrilling stargazing session, followed by a view of the Milky Way. As the first light of dawn breaks, witness the spectacular sunrise over the volcanic landscape of Bromo. The dormant Mount Batok, the active Mount Bromo, and the towering Mount Semeru are all part of this majestic view that stretches across the caldera. After sunrise, we continue our journey over the expansive Pasir (Sand Sea) in a 4WD, heading to the Poten Temple. From here, you can choose to either take a 3km hike or ride a pony to the base of Mount Bromo. A steep 253-step climb rewards you with a close-up view of the crater rim, where you can witness the raw power of the active volcano. We then set off for Madakaripura Waterfall, about an hour’s drive away. A short 30-minute trek through the lush greenery (wear your slippers!) will lead you to this magnificent waterfall, a stunning natural beauty nestled deep in the hills. After taking in the sight, we continue our journey to Bondowoso for an overnight stay.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text: Your day begins at midnight, as we head out from Bondowoso to Ijen. After a 90-minute drive to Paltuding, we’ll start the trek to Ijen Crater. This 1 to 1.5-hour hike leads you to the crater rim, where you’ll stand in awe of the 200-meter deep, turquoise sulfuric lake. You’ll also get to witness the grueling work of the local sulfur miners as they carry heavy sacks through toxic fumes and harsh terrain to make a living. After experiencing the crater’s sunrise view, we’ll descend and proceed to Ketapang Harbour, where you’ll board the ferry to Bali (ticket included). The journey to the island is the perfect way to conclude your Ijen adventure, as we leave Java behind and head to the tropical paradise of Bali.

After the waterfall, we’ll begin the scenic 4-hour journey back to your hotel or the airport in Surabaya, marking the end of our unforgettable program. itinerary_days.title: Day 1
itinerary_days.itinerary: Arrival in Surabaya & Transfer to Lumajang City
itinerary_days.activity_text:
Welcome to Surabaya & Journey to Malang
Your adventure begins with a pick-up from Surabaya Airport (preferably before 12:00 PM) and a scenic 3-hour drive to Lumajang City. Along the way, we will stop at a local restaurant for lunch (at your own expense). Upon arrival in Lumajang, check into your hotel, relax, and rest to prepare for the exciting days ahead.

itinerary_days.title: Day 2
itinerary_days.itinerary: Tumpak Sewu Waterfall & Journey to Bromo
itinerary_days.activity_text:
Tumpak Sewu Waterfall Adventure
Start the day with breakfast at the hotel, and then start to exploring Tumpak Sewu Waterfall. Known as the most beautiful waterfall in Java, Tumpak Sewu features a unique curtain-like water flow formed by multiple mini waterfalls cascading over a 300-meter-high cliff. The waterfalls form a semi-circular shape, and local legend has it that the waterfall is called "Sewu," meaning "one-thousand," due to the number of mini falls.
#next-stop#
Trekking to Tumpak Sewu & Water Spa
To fully appreciate the beauty of Tumpak Sewu, you will follow a trekking path up and over the rocks towards the top of the ravine, crossing the river at one point to reach Coban Sewu Waterfall. It’s recommended to wear proper trekking shoes or sandals. After spending time at the waterfall and enjoying the natural water spa, you’ll have lunch before continuing the journey to your hotel in the Bromo area, which takes approximately 4 hours by car.

itinerary_days.title: Day 3
itinerary_days.activity_text:
Bromo Sunrise & Stargazing Adventure
On this final day, prepare for an unforgettable sunrise experience at Mount Bromo. At around 01:00 AM, you will begin your journey to witness the majestic night sky and the Milky Way over Bromo. After enjoying the stargazing, head to the main viewpoint to witness the sunrise over the volcanic landscape, where Mount Batok, Mount Bromo, and Gunung Semeru (Java’s highest and most active volcano) stand tall.
#next-stop#
Explore Mount Bromo & Crater Rim
Following sunrise, you will take an exciting 4WD ride or motorcycle journey across the Laotan Pasir (Sand Sea) to Poten, a Tenggerese Hindu temple at the base of Mount Bromo. From Poten, you can either take a 3km hike or opt for a pony ride to reach the base of Mount Bromo. After climbing 253 steps to the crater rim, you will be rewarded with spectacular views of the crater itself.
#next-stop#
Return to Surabaya
After enjoying the breathtaking views of Mount Bromo's crater, you will return to the hotel for breakfast and check-out. Finally, continue your journey to your hotel or Surabaya Airport, with an estimated travel time of around 4 hours. End of the program.
